jsonFormatter.title: JSON Formatter Pro
jsonFormatter.description: Validate, format, and minify JSON, then inspect complete selected values and precise paths in the tree. Save JSONPath queries and recover failed copies with manual selection and retry.

treeView.empty: Enter valid JSON to see the tree view

guide.title: JSON Formatter Pro Complete Guide
guide.subtitle: JSON validation, formatting, tree selection, full-value copying, and saved JSONPath queries

features.syntaxHighlightDesc: Professional code editor powered by CodeMirror 6 with color-coded JSON keys, values, and types. Supports code folding, bracket matching, and line numbers.
features.treeViewDesc: Select nodes using distinct object keys and array indexes, then copy the complete JSON value, JSON Pointer, or verified JSONPath. Truncated tree labels do not truncate copied data.
features.jsonPathDesc: Extract data using JSONPath expressions. Supports complex filtering and recursive searches.
features.json5Desc: Supports JSON5 extended syntax including comments (// and /* */), trailing commas, and single quotes for easy config file processing.
features.statsDesc: Visualize type distribution, depth analysis, and most-used keys of your JSON data with interactive charts.
features.performanceDesc: Inspect the same JSON as formatted text, compact text, a tree, or statistics. Large documents and deep trees can take longer to process and render.

useCases.title: Use Cases
useCases.apiDebugDesc: Format API response JSON and extract needed data with JSONPath.
useCases.configEditDesc: Edit tsconfig, .eslintrc, and other JSON5 config files with comments.
useCases.dataAnalysisDesc: Understand JSON data structure and type distribution at a glance with the stats view.

tips.title: Tips
tips.tip1: Press Ctrl+Shift+F to format quickly, Ctrl+Shift+M to minify.
tips.tip2: Select a tree node, then explicitly copy its full value or path. Unsupported JSONPath keys show a notice; use JSON Pointer or the value instead.
tips.tip3: Enable JSON5 mode to parse config files with comments.
tips.tip4: Drag and drop files onto the editor to load them quickly.
tips.tip5: Use URL import to analyze external API JSON responses directly.

whatIs.title: What is JSON Formatter Pro?
whatIs.description: JSON Formatter Pro is a professional developer tool for validating, formatting, minifying, and analyzing JSON data. Built on the CodeMirror 6 editor, it offers syntax highlighting and error line indicators, along with JSONPath queries, JSON5/JSONC parsing, and automatic repair of broken JSON via jsonrepair. Use it for analyzing API responses, editing config files, validating data structures, and more.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: 1. Paste JSON into the editor or load a file.
2. Choose format, minify, tree, or statistics.
3. Select a tree node and copy its complete JSON value, JSON Pointer, or verified JSONPath.
4. Find values with a JSONPath expression and save frequently used queries by name. Use manual selection and retry if copying fails.

items.q: Does copying include strings truncated in the tree?
items.a: JSON-representable selections copy as complete JSON. The preview is divided into roughly 50,000 UTF-16-unit segments without shortening copied data. Selections containing NaN or Infinity show that value copying is unavailable instead of replacing them with null; paths remain available.

items.q: How are paths for special object keys handled?
items.a: Object keys and array indexes remain distinct, and JSON Pointer escapes slashes and tildes. JSONPath is checked against the current engine for the same value, with a notice for unsupported keys.

items.q: Are JSON documents and selected values saved?
items.a: Saved queries contain only a name and expression. This selection and path feature adds no persistent storage or transmission; an explicit copy sends the requested text to the clipboard.

presets.rootUnsupported: The current query engine could not evaluate this expression on this JSON root. Use $ for the entire root, or query an object or array.
presets.title: Saved expressions
presets.description: Save up to 12 named expressions. Loading fills the expression; press Run to see its results.
presets.storageHint: Only names and expressions are saved in this browser. JSON input and query results are not stored. Expressions can have up to 1,000 characters and names up to 40.
presets.name: Expression name
presets.expressionLimit: A saved expression must contain non-whitespace text and be no more than 1,000 characters in total.
presets.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}” from your saved expressions? Current inputs and results will remain.
presets.loaded: Filled in “{name}”. Your JSON input is unchanged; press Run to obtain results.

errors.corrupt: Saved expressions could not be read, so the original data was preserved. You can still run queries.
errors.unsupported: This saved format is unsupported, so the original data was preserved. You can still run queries.
errors.unavailable: Browser storage is unavailable, so the action could not finish. Check your storage settings.
errors.quota: There is not enough space to save the change. Existing expressions are preserved.
errors.conflict: Another tab changed the saved list, so the action stopped. Your current expression is intact; reload the list and select again.
errors.invalid: Enter a name of 1–40 characters and an expression with non-whitespace text, up to 1,000 characters.
errors.limit: You can save up to 12 expressions. Delete an unneeded saved expression first.
errors.duplicate: An expression with this name already exists. Enter a different name.

selection.title: Selected node
selection.hint: Inspect the selected value and path. Copy uses the complete content, not just the preview segment.
selection.rootPointer: The root JSON Pointer is an empty string. It differs from /, which points to an empty object key.
selection.checking: Checking that this path identifies the selected node exactly.

pathStatus.unsupported: This key combination cannot be represented exactly by the current JSONPath engine. Use JSON Pointer or the JSON value.
pathStatus.unavailable: JSONPath support could not be checked. Select the node again or use JSON Pointer.

valueStatus.nonFinite: The selection contains NaN or Infinity, which JSON cannot preserve. Nothing was changed to null. Path copying remains available.
valueStatus.notJsonValue: The selection contains a value that JSON cannot represent. Use path copying instead.
valueStatus.serializationFailed: The selection could not be serialized as JSON. Select another node or use path copying.

selection.previewRange: UTF-16 units {start}–{end} of {total} · segment {page}/{pages}. Copy includes the full value.

recovery.failed: Copy failed. Select the full content below manually or retry.
recovery.hint: This field contains the full content. Large content may take time to display and select. After selecting, use your device’s copy command.
recovery.selectionFailed: Automatic selection failed. Select the text directly in the field.
